title: Locally constructible ordinary direct-image ranks on residue-field fibres
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat proper and locally of finite presentation, with $X,S$ schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and $E$ a finite locally free $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. Fix $r\in\mathbb N$. Write $q_s:X_s\to X$ and $p_s:X_s\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ for the fibre projections [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-residue-field]. Then $\{s\in S\mid p_{s,*}q_s^*E\text{ is finite locally free of rank }r\}$ is locally constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Here $q_s^*$ is tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], $p_{s,*}$ is ordinary module pushforward [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and fixed rank means [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. No constant-rank assumption is imposed on E along a whole fibre.

source.place: Clause (3), applied to Rf_*E from Tag 0B91(2), as in Tag 0BDP second proof paragraph

proof.text: E is finitely presented and flat over S: it is finite locally free on X and f is flat. Properness and local finite presentation give finite presentation of f. Apply perfect direct image and arbitrary base change (Tag 0B91(2)) to E.

On Spec kappa(s), its derived fibre has degree-zero cohomology equal to the ordinary direct image of E pulled back to X_s. This uses the canonical derived-to-ordinary pullback comparison and degree-zero direct-image identification.

A quasi-coherent module on the spectrum of a field is finite locally free of rank r exactly when its vector space of global sections has dimension r. The vector spaces here are finite dimensional by perfectness.

Consequently the displayed locus is the degree-zero Betti-number level set of Rf_*E. Perfect implies pseudo-coherent, and Tag 0BDI(3) makes this set locally constructible. On an empty fibre the vector space is zero, so such points occur precisely in the level r=0.
